FN-MBPJWWH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 336
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/01/2024
House Bill 336 as introduced would allow for an officer of the state, county, or municipality to
also serve as a director of a local water, sewer, or fire protection authority without
compensation.
Page 1

water, sewer, or fire protection authority without compensation.

Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/22/2024

authority without compensation.
